notes.title: Big bugfix update (1.3.3 game version)
notes.content:
The update included:
1. Fixed a critical bug in the dungeon
2. Fixed bug with stove and chocolate
3. Fixed layers of candles in the room with mirrors
4. Fixed diary behavior when the poison detector is open
5. Removed dialogues after using items in the museum

Some internal optimizations have also been done.

notes.title: The official soundtrack for Detective From The Crypt
notes.content:
The official soundtrack for Detective From The Crypt immerses the listener in the mystical world of the game. Compositions are created in trance style. Most tunes are looped and can be played for hours.

Detective From The Crypt Soundtrack is composed by BOV.

Tracklist:

1. Menu
2. Bad End
3. Bagpipe
4. Cave
5. Cemetery Melody
6. Chirch
7. Clock
8. Crypt
9. Egypt
10. Hall Fall Down
11. Hall Fall Down Organ
12. Harpsichord
13. Nock Nock
14. Sad
15. Spirits
16. Trance
17. Trance 2
18. Trance Soft Strings
19. Trance Sounds UP
20. Trance Two Floor
